decisions.reason: As a small accessory it is easier to discontinue than a trailer line, but after several years on the market management can still justify keeping it as a modest add-on and attribute any weak demand to normal assortment fluctuations.
This box car trailer series is a visible multi-model commitment in the firm's core business, so sunk development costs, public positioning, and strategic fit strongly favor continued support.
The car transporter trailer line remains close to the firm's core capabilities and growth direction, making management likely to persist unless there is unmistakable evidence of sustained failure.
The low-bed trailer series sits squarely in the firm's main transport offering and was prominently presented, so escalation of commitment makes withdrawal within the next year unlikely.
